resources.string: Start or stop a meeting recording
Lock the screen — it keeps running
Recording carries on with the screen off or in another app. Stop, pause or mark a moment from the notification or the widget without unlocking.
The mic has heard nothing for 45 seconds
Most often something is over the mic, or another app has grabbed the audio input. The file is still being written either way.
Audio captured now is saved and queued; it transcribes automatically the moment the download lands. You do not have to wait here.
Every meeting and transcript as one file you keep.
Adds the meetings from a Meeting Transcript backup. Nothing already here is replaced.
Recommended. The transcript is kept; only the recording is removed, and only once it has been transcribed.
A short window to fix the speaker count before the recording is removed. Separating voices again needs the audio.
Every meeting, transcript and recording on this phone.
Records a meeting and turns it into a timestamped transcript, entirely on this phone. No account, no upload, works in aeroplane mode.
Recording other people has rules that vary by jurisdiction and employer. That part is on you.
Asks whether to keep going, and pauses if there is no answer. Guards against a recording left running after everyone has left.
Works through the meeting as it goes, so a long recording is mostly transcribed by the time you stop it. Turn off if the phone struggles.
Splits the transcript by voice. Often wrong with more than two or three people — it can merge two speakers into one, or attribute words to the wrong person.
Downloading… it carries on if you leave this screen.
Speaker labels are experimental and are often wrong. Two people can be merged into one, and words can be attributed to the wrong person. Read them as a hint, never as a record of who said what.
Listening… a rough transcript appears here as people talk. The accurate one is made when you stop.
Live preview needs the speech models. The recording is fine — it will be transcribed once they are downloaded.
Name it while you still remember
Skip it and the app drafts a name from the first words of the transcript.
Optional. Helps speaker labels, which are in beta and often wrong.
A one-tap widget starts and stops recording without opening the app.
One tap to start or stop a recording.
Your launcher does not support adding widgets from an app. Long-press the home screen, choose Widgets and find Meeting Transcript.
Microphone access is off for this app. Turn it on in Settings to record.
Only %1$s free. An hour of recording takes about 115 MB, and a recording stops by itself when less than 100 MB is left.
Stop the recording before deleting it.
%s\n\nNothing is synced anywhere, so this cannot be recovered. Exported copies are unaffected.
%1$s of %2$s so far. It carries on by itself when the phone is on Wi-Fi.

Everything runs on this phone, so the models have to live on it.

• Live preview — %1$s. A small, fast model that shows rough words while you record.
• Accurate transcript — %2$s. The model that writes the transcript you keep.
• Speaker models — %3$s. Used only if you turn on Identify speakers.

Downloaded once. After that the app works in aeroplane mode.
Recordings will now be transcribed on this phone.
%s, once. After this, transcription runs entirely on this device — no account, no upload, works in aeroplane mode.
Starting… it carries on if you close the app.
%1$s of %2$s so far. The connection dropped; it picks up where it left off.
Stopped after several tries (%s). What already arrived is kept, so resuming does not start again from zero.
About %s left to download. Wait for Wi-Fi and it starts by itself when the phone connects, or use mobile data now.
Tap Record when the meeting starts. The audio and the transcript stay on this phone.
Searches meeting names and transcript text.
Copied — paste it into any chatbot
Waiting for the speech models. It transcribes by itself once they are downloaded.
Queued. It starts by itself — nothing to do here.
This meeting is still being recorded.
Based on speaker labels, which are in beta and often wrong. Treat these numbers as a rough sketch.
The transcript appears here as it is made.
The recording was cut off — the app or the phone stopped mid-meeting. What was captured is kept; go back to the list and it is picked up for transcription.
Lines appear below as each part is done. It carries on if you leave this screen.
The system paused it part-way through. It picks up where it stopped.
Takes a minute or two. The words stay the same; only the speaker labels change.
Who did most of the talking?
The recording was deleted after transcribing, so voices cannot be separated again.
Turn on Identify speakers in Settings, or fix the speaker count, to see who talked how much.
